shared_elements: schematic human figure with outstretched arms
repeated linear/tally-like marks in a row
abstract curvilinear motifs on the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic anthropomorphic imagery with a frontal figure whose arms extend outward and a disc-like circular element, plus rows of short repeated marks, but these are near-universal conventions. B is a narrative scene with a striding axe-wielding figure, a quadruped and a manned boat with a curved prow, while A is a sculpted standing personage whose body is covered with static emblematic motifs (circles, bands, headdress panels) rather than any narrative action, so relationships and arrangement correspond only vaguely.
